comment: Recently brought some frozen food which is good especially those vegan foods. The quality and pricing of the products are good. They are doing bulk orders also for marriage function and more.

I recently visited a place near Kavundapalayam. The products were really good—veg fish, veg chicken, and veg mutton. The taste was exactly like non-veg. Everyone should definitely visit this place and explore it.

I tried food at mock meat,It was an amazing experience that I first time tried a very different food amazed by its taste. I love this new concept they tried in food. I think even a crazy non-veg lovers also fell in love with this taste.
